svg.title: How the whole project fits together
svg.desc: Five layers from the people who use it, down to the test pod they check. A five step journey of one release runs across the top.
svg.text: Read it from top to bottom. Your tests are plain files you own. Nothing ever runs against production.
The journey of one Oracle quarterly update
In a real browser and with
REST calls, on a test pod
web pages on your own computer, or the qm command line
run, plan, record, validate, export, packs, audit: the same engine as the pages
one small program on your computer, started with qm serve
starts a separate process per run
the parts that do the real work
plain files on your disk, you can back them up
only the test pod and chosen helpers
everything here is optional except the pod
Safe by design: production is refused unless explicitly allowed. AI only suggests, a person accepts.
Private data is masked before any AI sees it. Passwords and keys are never printed, logged or sent to the browser.
